summary: Refined system architecture by integrating PEP 487-based registries and a complexity-weighted Objective Prioritization Engine, while simultaneously transitioning to a Topological Knowledge Dependency Graph (TKDG) to manage prerequisite hierarchies. These structural shifts prioritize high-signal architectural output and logical knowledge validation over raw task volume.
key_learnings: PEP 487 and structural hashing provide robust defense against state-space ambiguity.
Formalizing prioritization via (Impact × Urgency) / Complexity reduces cognitive bias.
Representing knowledge as a DAG prevents cognitive overload by enforcing foundational mastery.
Atomic node granularity and transitive reduction are essential for maintaining the predictive power of dependency graphs.
